findings.passage: Pennsylvania law requires voters casting their ballot for the first time at a polling place to present an approved form of identification.
findings.note: Official Senate e-newsletter titled 'Important Election Information' (listed on the newsletter index as October 14, 2026), a voter reminder before the November 3, 2026 general election. It states the current first-time ID rule and links to the approved-ID list. It does not say whether he wants the rule changed.
